item.title: Basic Workbench
item.description: The Basic Workbench is the first crafting station you build in Core Keeper. It unlocks the initial tool and equipment recipes. Use Crafts the Copper Pickaxe, Copper Sword and other early items Upgrade path: Iron Anvil → Gold Anvil → Scarlet Workbench

item.title: Cooking Pot
item.description: The Cooking Pot is built early and used throughout the whole game to turn raw ingredients into food buffs. Use Draws ingredients from adjacent chests, so line it up with storage Golden ingredients always produce rare (or epic with the Master Chef talent) food Cooked food gives damage, mining and healing buffs essential for bosses

item.title: Copper Anvil
item.description: The Copper Anvil is the first anvil you build, unlocking copper-tier armor and weapons after the Basic Workbench. Use Crafts the Copper Helm, Copper Breastplate, Copper Pants, Copper Sword and Wooden Shield Made at the Copper Workbench from 8 Copper Bar Upgrade path: Tin Anvil → Iron Anvil

item.title: Furnace
item.description: The Furnace is the first ore-processing station in Core Keeper, smelting raw ore into bars for tools and equipment. It’s the bridge between mining copper/tin and crafting metal gear. What it processes Copper Ore → Copper Bar Tin Ore → Tin Bar Later: Iron, Gold and Scarlet bars for higher tiers The parallel furnace trick You can’t speed up a single furnace’s smelting time — but you can build several furnaces and process ores concurrently.

item.title: Iron Anvil
item.description: The Iron Anvil is the Forgotten Ruins anvil, the workbench for iron- and gold-tier equipment. Use Crafts the Iron Helm, Iron Breastplate, Iron Pants, Iron Shield, Iron Sword, Iron Halberd and Iron Bow Made at the Iron Workbench from 10 Iron Bar Also includes all recipes from the Copper and Tin Anvils

item.title: Salvage and Repair Station
item.description: The Salvage and Repair Station is built early and stays useful for the entire playthrough. Use Repairs the durability of your tools, weapons and armor Salvages unwanted gear back into base materials Cheap to make (5 Copper Bar) — place it next to your crafting area

item.title: Smelter Kiln
item.description: The Smelter Kiln is the second-tier ore refiner, used once you have mined past copper, tin and iron. Use Refines Gold Ore, Scarlet Ore and Octarine Ore into their bars Copper, Tin and Iron are still smelted in the basic Furnace; Galaxite needs the Fury Forge Runs automatically — add multiple kilns to keep up with automated drill setups

item.title: Tin Anvil
item.description: The Tin Anvil is the clay-caves anvil, used once you have moved on from copper gear in The Clay Caves. Use Crafts the Bronze Helm, Bronze Breastplate and Bronze Pants Unlocks the Slingshot (first ranged weapon) and Wooden Shield, which blocks 70% of damage when held Also includes all recipes from the Copper Anvil
